title: Golden / behaviour tests v1
description: Behaviour-test suite for a generated subagent (Step 5 golden tests + Step 11 generated suites). Lives at tests/golden-tests.yaml (authored) or tests/behaviour-tests.yaml (Step-11 generated). Three single-turn test sections — golden_tests (the expert does its job, expected_route invoke), negative_routing_tests (out-of-scope, expected_route do_not_invoke), missing_context_tests (underspecified, must_ask_for non-empty) — matching tools.subagent_factory.behaviour_replay._TEST_SECTIONS, so the suite is graded directly by behaviour_replay. principle_coverage links a test back to the principle ids it exercises.
